model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language categories. The horizontal axis, labeled "family," contains discrete categories arranged in alphabetical order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," uses a linear scale with a visible data range from approximately -5 to 35, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30) and corresponding horizontal grid lines. Within each language family category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into groups of six adjacent bars. According to the legend, these bars represent different configurations, distinguished by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). All bars feature black outlines and vertical black error bars with caps. The bar heights vary widely across the chart; the tallest bar is the mBERT-B₂ (light red) bar in the IE-Indic group, reaching an approximate value of 24, with its error bar extending above 30. Conversely, some bars represent negative values, such as the mBERT-R₂ (light green) bar in the Semitic group, which extends downward to approximately -2.5. Groups such as Isolate and Uralic display consistently low effect values across all six configurations, with all bars in those groups remaining close to zero.
